meaning.vi: Theo cách mò mẫm; một cách mù quáng.

meaning_vi: sờ soạng, lần mò; dò dẫm, mò mẫm

sentences.en: He put his hand out gropingly, touched hers.
sentences.vi: Anh mò mẫm đưa tay ra, chạm vào tay cô.

sentences.en: Soul seeks soul, gropingly, and finds it.
sentences.vi: Linh hồn tìm kiếm linh hồn, mò mẫm, và tìm thấy nó.

sentences.en: He put his hand gropingly, touched hers.
sentences.vi: Anh đưa tay sờ soạng, chạm vào tay cô.

sentences.en: Hands out gropingly, he went toward Katherine.
sentences.vi: Đưa tay ra một cách dò dẫm, anh ta đi về phía Katherine.

sentences.en: 'Then you must be familiar withthiscountry. Do you speak Chinese?'Jack gropingly.

sentences.en: As a newly established commercial bank, Postal Savings Bank of China(PSBC) gets ahead gropingly in many aspects, especially having a big gap comparing with other commercial banks.

sentences.en: At present, China's economic development is at an important period, market economy progress gropingly.
